rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose standalone pronoun when “them” refers to more than one person.

example.english: They said they would come tonight, but I don't believe them.
example.traditional: 佢哋話今晚會嚟，但我唔信佢哋。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 waa6 gam1 maan5 wui5 lai4 daan6 ngo5 m4 seon3 keoi5 dei6

rows.note: Use this when singular “them” refers to one person, as in singular they.

example.english: Someone called looking for you, but I don't know them.
example.traditional: 有人打電話搵你，但我唔識佢。
example.jyutping: jau5 jan4 daa2 din6 waa2 wan2 nei5 daan6 ngo5 m4 sik1 keoi5
